name: era-advance
description: Drive play into era 4 (2001), the final era, so its rendering/gameplay routines run, and pixel-validate them against MAME.
_grounding: 0xAD04 holds the RAW era 0..4 (not packed); era 4 = 0x04, confirmed under MAME (neg control 0x40 corrupts PLAY_ACTIVE). Direct held poke is coherent+stable (era held, PLAY_ACTIVE=0xFF, actors churning 500 frames); this tape holds the era; the transition into an era is round-won.poke.json and mothership-era*.poke.json.
_reaches: postLifeStartCaptionsAndResetPlayfield runs only before the era poke lands (outside the compared window), so it is not declared. stepCountdownSlotThenCloseTurn (0x4108) is inlined into serviceSlotByMarkerThenCloseSweepTurn as its drifting-countdown arm; no slot in this tape carries a drifting marker, so this tape does not declare it; countdown-slot.poke.json covers it.
